The languages included in the &th Schedule of the Constitution are:
Assamese,  Bengali, Gujrati, Hindi, Kannada,  Kashmiri, Konkani
Malyalam, Manipuri, Marathi; Nepalese, Oriya, Punjabi, Sanskrit,
